subject: Re: Stalled Zip onboarding — auth code rotation causing SSO hang
messages:
From: Arielle Nunez <arielle@velvetworks.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: support+logs@velvetworks.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Zip onboarding hangs at 'Verifying' after accepting invite

Hi Marcus,

We're seeing a blocking issue for our supplier onboarding into Zip. Users accept the invite and get redirected to the Zip login flow, but the screen hangs on 'Verifying your account' for >30s and then times out. From our side the IdP returns a 200 and the SAML response looks fine, but the auth_code the portal expects doesn't match (we see an "invalid or expired auth_code" error in the portal trace). We rotated our signing keys yesterday — not sure if that correlates.

I've attached a small trace (velvet-sso-trace-20260711.json) and a sample SAML response (saml-response-sample.txt). Can you help? This is blocking our procurement kickoff with a big customer next week.

Thanks,
Arielle Nunez
Head of Ops, VelvetWorks
arielle@velvetworks.com

--
Attachment: velvet-sso-trace-20260711.json (application/json, 78KB)
Attachment: saml-response-sample.txt (text/plain, 6KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Nunez <arielle@velvetworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zip onboarding hangs at 'Verifying' after accepting invite

Thanks for the quick details, Arielle — appreciate the traces. Sorry you're hitting this.

Short answer: this looks like an auth_code rotation edge where the portal cache still expects the pre-rotation code and the IdP is issuing a new one. Two options we can take immediately:

1) Temporary workaround: we can re-issue the invite link from our side which forces a fresh auth_code binding for the session. That usually clears the hang for affected users.

2) Longer fix: adjust the auth_code TTL or add a grace period for key-rotation windows so the portal accepts the previous key for N minutes after rotation. Our infra team has a config flag (auth_code_grace_minutes) we can bump.

Ben, can you take a look at the trace and advise whether reissuing the invite is safe for VelvetWorks' workflow, and whether we should implement a short-term config bump? Monica — I'll loop you for procurement status and communications to the VelvetWorks onboarding list.

Arielle — can you confirm how many users are affected and whether you're able to try a re-issued invite? If you prefer, we can re-run a targeted invite to a test account.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Quoted attachments preserved from previous message.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Arielle Nunez <arielle@velvetworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zip onboarding hangs at 'Verifying' after accepting invite

Thanks Marcus — reviewed the trace. Notes:

- The SSO exchange completes but the portal's auth_code lookup fails at the token validation layer. The trace shows two auth_code values in .exchange: auth_code_v1 (issued at 09:02:10) and auth_code_v2 (issued at 09:02:47). The portal received v2 but an upstream cache was still keyed on v1 for a short window.

- Root cause appears to be key rotation + cache propagation lag. When the IdP rotates signing keys, we still accept assertions signed by both keys for a configurable grace period. VelvetWorks' IdP rotation happened ~09:00, which matches the window.

Short-term suggestions I can push right now (low risk):

- Reissue all outstanding invites for the org (this forces a new auth_code binding). I can automate this for a small subset if you give me test emails.
- Increase auth_code_grace_minutes from 2 -> 10 to tolerate your rotation schedule for the next 24 hours. I'll add monitoring to ensure we don't increase replay risk.

If you want me to run both: reissue invites for 3 test users + bump TTL for 4 hours, say yes and I'll do it now. I'll attach the sanitized debug we used: sso-debug-snippet.log.

Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zip onboarding hangs at 'Verifying' after accepting invite

Marcus / Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround. We tried your suggested steps: you reissued the invite to our three test accounts (arielle.test@velvetworks.com, onboarding1@velvetworks.com, onboarding2@velvetworks.com) and bumped the grace window. All three can now complete the Zip flow and create POs.

We also confirmed that rotating keys during off-hours + notifying Redwood before rotation prevents the issue going forward. We'll coordinate key rotations with Monica from procurement. Please close JIRA-ONB-789 when you're set.

Appreciate the help — saved our timeline for the customer kickoff.

Best,
Arielle
